lines.text: Every year, a public firm tells investors how it is doing, through two channels in one annual report.
lines.say: Every year, a public firm tells investors how it is doing, through two channels, in one annual report.

lines.text: Item 8, the financial statements, is strict. GAAP has a rule for almost every line, and auditors check it.
lines.say: Item eight, the financial statements, is strict. Gap has a rule for almost every line, and auditors check it.

lines.text: Item 7, the MD&A, is management's own narrative. It is far more flexible.
lines.say: Item seven, the M D and A, is management's own story. It is far more flexible.

lines.text: For a factory-style firm, the statements work well: earnings and book value explain the stock price.
lines.say: For a factory-style firm, the statements work well. Earnings and book value explain the stock price.

lines.text: But value built on ideas, software and brands doesn't fit GAAP's boxes. Price drifts away from the numbers.
lines.say: But value built on ideas, software and brands doesn't fit gap's boxes. The price drifts away from the numbers.

lines.text: The authors call this financial statement inadequacy: one minus that R-squared.
lines.say: The authors call this, financial statement inadequacy. One, minus that R squared.

lines.text: So what does the manager do? Just comply and move on, or turn to the flexible channel?
lines.say: So what does the manager do? Just comply, and move on? Or turn to the flexible channel?

lines.text: They turn. Firms with weaker statements discuss non-GAAP measures more, tailored to their own situation.
lines.say: They turn. Firms with weaker statements discuss non-gap measures more, tailored to their own situation.

lines.text: And they write more forward-looking statements, so investors can see where the firm is heading.
lines.say: And they write more forward-looking statements, so investors can see where the firm is heading.

lines.text: From the most to the least adequate firms, non-GAAP discussion rises by 19 percent,
lines.say: From the most, to the least adequate firms, non-gap discussion rises by nineteen percent,

lines.text: and forward-looking sentences rise by about 5 percent.
lines.say: and forward-looking sentences rise by about five percent.

lines.text: The MD&As are read by machine. Keywords catch non-GAAP talk; a deep-learning network spots forward-looking sentences.
lines.say: The M D and A's are read by machine. Keywords catch non-gap talk. A deep-learning network spots forward-looking sentences.

lines.text: TopicTiling cuts each document into topics. The extra disclosure appears where traditional reporting is weakest, such as intangibles.

lines.text: So managers use their channels together, like a mosaic. When one is constrained, the other carries more.
